diego: locking final run-of-show for Wed 4/9 public webinar — quick sync? need speaker order, demo fallback, and lead-routing rules.
asha: yes. proposed speaker order: sofia (context + abstract), lee (benchmarks), ben (customer story + demo), diego (q&a/mod). aiming 40m talk + 15m q&a. :clock1:
sofia: i’ll tighten the abstract to 3 bullets and flag 2 portfolio slides for the demo. deck link -> https://drive.redwood.example/s/abc123 (will update tonight).
ben: demo note — cold-starts can blow token budget. primary demo on dedicated pool, fallback to hosted quantized variant if latency spikes. lee can own the fallback smoke. :thumbsup:
lee: can run canary/test on tuesday 10am PT. sample script i'll use: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"model":"dedicated-v1","input":"short demo prompt"}'
```
sofia: thx. also recommend we reserve 3 live prompts from product & 3 from security to avoid surprise regressions.
diego: good call. routing: leads from attendee form should go to SDR queue A for ABM + a CSV export to product-marketing. we need an automation rule for hot leads (>50% intent).
asha: inbound routing rules:
- attend_type=enterprise -> sdr-abm
- company_size>500 -> sdr-enterprise
- trials_requested=true -> product-marketing alert
can we map fields to HubSpot property names before launch?
ben: yes, i'll map and share field list by EOD.
sofia: run-of-show draft (30 min content + 15 q). copying plain block for producers:
```
00:00 - 00:02  host intro (diego)
00:02 - 00:08  state of inference (sofia)
00:08 - 00:18  benchmark deep-dive (lee)
00:18 - 00:28  customer demo & impact (ben)
00:28 - 00:30  quick callouts + CTA (sofia)
00:30 - 00:45  live q&a (panel)
```
lee: suggest adding a 1-min demo warmup step at 00:16 to pre-warm KV cache for the live demo. prevent cold-run artifacts.
diego: done — update in deck. prod note: set demo region to us-west-2 and pre-spin 1 extra GPU node at 00:15 for safety.
webinar-bot: recording enabled, captions ON, chat moderation mode: APPROVE_ALL.
asha: rehearsal schedule:
- tech check (all speakers + producers): Tue 10am PT (canary verification)
- full run rehearsal: Wed 9am PT (30m)
- backup dry-run (producer only): Wed 1pm PT
who's available for Tue 10?

sofia: ✅
